title: 第3章 白骨道地牢之主第4章 熟人来了
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
“呵，没杀死我。”
夜洐缓慢抬起头，所有魔气都被吞噬在额头竖痕中。
“真成了？”
等待分赃狞笑的凶人们，喉咙仿佛被魔手扼住，发不出半点声音。
他们坚信不疑的修炼观，彻底崩塌了。
“刚才你们笑的很开心。”夜洐抬头看向他们，看着他们躲闪的眼神，后退的脚步，都拼命把身体藏在黑暗中。
角色互换了。
他们曾经再凶再强，现在只能依靠肉身的力量，相当于只在第一境。
而夜洐，纳魔气入体，在这里可使用第二境能力。
夜洐宛如盯着猎物的目光，不由舔了舔嘴唇。
之前腰窄肩宽，身材挺拔的夜洐，现在瘦骨嶙峋，皮包骨头。
很饿。
非常饿。
体内一切能量被掏的干干净净。
刚才修炼太始魔经，让魔气重塑了筋骨血肉，在打碎重组中，提高了生命层次。
之前夜洐在第一境“命修境”，肉身力量达到七千五百斤。
现在。
没有专门的器具，夜洐无法准确评估。
“一万斤？”
夜洐单靠肉身力量攥紧身上的玄铁锁链，非万斤力道不可损的玄铁锁链，开始变形。

“肉身力量达到万斤？第一境命修境的极限。”
不单单是肉身力量增加两千多斤。
更是代表着生命层次的提升，代表天赋根骨的提升。
根骨天赋的参差，奇珍异宝，神药奇血的温养，造就每个人在命修境极限所不同。
有人极限不过千斤。
有人却能破五千。
代表着天赋底蕴的差别，未来成就的高低。
五千可成天才，夜洐曾经达到七千五，已经是隐龙城年轻一代首屈一指的天骄人物，这还是夜洐没有跟其他豪门子弟一样从小秘药奇血养体。
传闻凌云璃曾在第一境，超越八千斤。
由此被大瑞朝封为公主。
传闻各路初祖，有可能打破九千斤。
而万斤只存在传说中。
生命层次提高，压榨了夜洐体内所有的能量，饿到极致。
地牢别想有富含气血能量的食物。
夜洐绿油油盯着罪犯凶人们。
凶人们慌了。
content_en:
"Oh, you didn't kill me."
Ye Tao slowly raised his head, and all the demonic energy was swallowed up in the vertical marks on his forehead.
"Is it really done?"
The murderers who were waiting to divide their spoils were grinning ferociously, as if their throats were being strangled by demonic hands, unable to make a single sound.
Their unshakable view of cultivation completely collapsed.
"You were laughing so happily just now." Ye Tao looked up at them, watching their evasive eyes and retreating steps, trying their best to hide their bodies in the darkness.
The roles are reversed.
They were once fierce and powerful, but now they can only rely on the power of the physical body, which is equivalent to being in the first realm.
Ye Hui, on the other hand, absorbs demonic energy into his body, and can use his second realm abilities here.
Ye Tao looked like he was staring at prey and couldn't help but lick his lips.
Ye Gu, who used to have a narrow waist, broad shoulders and a tall figure, is now skinny and skinny.
Very hungry.
Very hungry.
All the energy in the body was drained away.
Just now, I practiced the Taishi Demonic Sutra, which allowed the demonic energy to reshape the muscles, bones, flesh and blood, and in the process of breaking and reorganizing, my life level was improved.
Previously, Ye Hui was in the first realm, "Life Cultivation Realm", and his physical strength reached 7,500 kilograms.
Now.
Noctis cannot be accurately assessed without specialized equipment.
"Ten thousand pounds?"
Ye Hao relied solely on his physical strength to grasp the dark iron chain tightly around his body. The dark iron chain, which could not be damaged without the strength of ten thousand kilograms, began to deform.
"The physical strength reaches ten thousand kilograms? The limit of the first level of life cultivation."
Not only is the physical strength increased by more than 2,000 kilograms.
It also represents the improvement of life level and the improvement of talent and talent.
The differences in the talent of the bones, the rare treasures, and the warmth of the magical medicine and blood make everyone different at the limit of life cultivation.
Some people's limit is no more than a thousand pounds.
Some people can break five thousand.
It represents the difference in talent and foundation and the level of future achievements.
Five thousand people can make you a genius, and Ye Hui once reached 7,500, and he is already the leading genius of the younger generation in Hidden Dragon City. This is because Ye Hui did not nourish his body with secret medicine and blood like other children from wealthy families.
It is rumored that Ling Yunli once surpassed eight thousand kilograms in the first realm.
As a result, she was named a princess by Darui Dynasty.
It is rumored that the ancestors of various walks of life may break the nine thousand kilograms.
Ten thousand catties only exist in legends.
The improvement of life level squeezed out all the energy in Ye Gu's body, making her hungry to the extreme.
Don’t even think about having food rich in blood energy in the dungeon.
The green night tree stared at the criminals.
The murderers panicked.
